beats.narration_text: Youtube-publisher has three beats. B00: a Medhavy Remotion intro with AI narration naming the chapter. B50: the raw NotebookLM video — untouched, its own audio, never re-encoded. B99: the Medhavy outro. Plus the tooling around it: a Whisper transcript, a chapter matcher, a description builder, and publish_playlist.py for chapter-ordered upload.

beats.narration_text: The pipeline: transcribe with faster-whisper. Match to a chapter — human gate. Write B00, B50, B99 beat sheet. Voice only the bookends — B50 is never sent to TTS. Render bookends via Remotion. Sandwich all three into the upload master. Propose chapter markers. Build and rewrite the description — human gate. Publish in chapter order — human gate. Defaults to unlisted until the audit passes.

beats.narration_text: Law one: body untouched. The NotebookLM video is never re-encoded or re-narrated. As the SKILL says: keep the NotebookLM body untouched. The value of this skill is that it doesn't re-encode or re-narrate the deep dive — it only bookends and publishes it. B50 skips TTS. It skips Remotion. It goes straight into the sandwich as-is.

beats.narration_text: Law two: chapter match gates playlist position. TF-IDF ranks every chapter and the top hit sets the position. The auto-match is usually right — but as the SKILL says: a wrong match silently reorders the playlist. That's why the chapter match is a human gate. Show the ranking. Confirm before continuing. Override if the auto-match is wrong.

props.heading: Chapter match gates order.
props.body: TF-IDF auto-match is usually right. But confirm it — wrong chapter number silently puts your video in the wrong playlist slot. Show the ranking; wait for human sign-off.

props.sparkLine: Auto-match is fast. Wrong match is invisible. Confirm it.

beats.narration_text: Law three: three gates, then publish. Chapter match, description rewrite, upload confirm. As the SKILL says: treat steps 2, 8, and 9 as the places to slow down. The transcript and chapter match are cheap to redo. The upload is not. And publishing defaults to unlisted — public is a manual Studio flip. The human decides when the video goes live.
